reviews.text:
The app mostly works well but getting notifications from “Other” apps than the listed ones does not work. I’ve had similar smartwatches before that pushes ANY notifications on the phone to the watch. This does not. I get SMS and WhatsApp notifications only.

One thing I wish were different, I would like to be able to enter my location to get a correct weather forecast. If I’m able to change the location to mine, I don’t know where to find it. reviews.title: Feature Request
reviews.text:
Hi! I really like using your GloryFit app with my smartwatch, especially because I bought the watch as an affordable way to have a watch that I can use at school and throughout the day.

One feature I would really love to see added in a future update is a game section or mini app store for compatible smartwatches. It would be really fun if users could choose from simple games and download them directly onto their watch.

I know the watches are affordable, so even having a few simple games would be amazing! Games like puzzles, memory games, or other small games that can be played directly on the watch would make it even more fun and useful.

Thank you for considering this suggestion! 💗⌚🎮

reviews.title: Not family friendly
reviews.text: My issue is I have kids and want to have them use watches that are set up with GloryFit, and it’s not possible unless they also hook up to some device. It’s not about WiFi or Bluetooth but just being able to set the time and alarms. I want to be able to switch between profiles. Or even if I had two watches that are mine, I can’t simply unpair one then pair the second, I have to unpair and also uninstall the app then re-install and re-pair every time. If you could make multiple profiles possible that would be amazing!
